usage: The word '返學' (faan1 hok6) is used as a verb meaning 'to go to school'.
It can be used when talking about daily routines involving attending school.
You can combine it with different subjects and time phrases to make various sentences.
'返學' sometimes appears with modal verbs to express intentions or abilities.
In casual speech, '返學' is commonly used to refer to leaving home to attend classes.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1zou2 cat1 dim2 faan1 hok6.
examples.meaning: I go to school at 7 in the morning.

examples.jyutping: sing1kei4 jat1 ngo5 mou5 dak1 faan1 hok6.
examples.meaning: I don't have to go to school on Monday.
What time do you go to school?

examples.jyutping: sai3 lou2 mui5 jat6 gau2 dim2 faan1 hok6.
examples.meaning: Little brother goes to school at 9 every day.
